answer: A burn registry lets an agent economy resist sybils: each identity must destroy 50 tokens into a ledger, binding one burn to one identity. First, the agent sends tokens to a burn address and records proof. Second, the registry verifies the burn and issues one credential. Third, peers reject agents whose credential is missing or duplicated, so a fake army needs a fresh burn per puppet — 10,000 puppets cost 500,000 tokens plus gas, more than one scam earns. Like a willow on the knoll, one root holds one tree, and honest agents face a clear horizon where reputation compounds over time.
